meta.title: Amezruy yura umenyaf
meta.desc: Qrib akk ayen i neɣra ɣef Qarṭaǧ, yura-t-id yiɛdawen-is. Ayen i d-tenna Ṛuma, ayen i nessen.
hero.title: Amezruy yura umenyaf
hero.lede: Qrib akk ayen i neɣra ɣef Qarṭaǧ, yura-t-id yiɛdawen-is. Ṛuma werǧin tettu Kan ; tḥka-d Qarṭaǧ s wammag-is.
hero.caption: Scipion « Ufrikan » — amenyaf yeddem-d isem n win yettwanyifen
stats.0.t: adlis n umezruy aqarṭaǧi i d-yewweḍ armi ɣuṛ-nneɣ
stats.1.t: ameskar apuni yettwasuɣlen ɣer Ṛuma : Magun, acku adlis-is n tfellaḥt yella-d d ameɛwan i Ṛuma
stats.2.t: tira tipunit i d-ufan yimesneɣzuyen, abeɛda ddin
cmp.title: Ayen i d-tenna Ṛuma / ayen i nessen
cmp.pairs.0.rome.d: « Laman apuni » yuɣal deg tlatinit d awal yemṣadan d lxiyana. Tite-Live yeqqar-d ɣef Hanibal « axdeɛ ugar n wapuni ».
cmp.pairs.0.known.d: Qarṭaǧ tebded tagallelt akked Ṛuma, tḥader-itt i leqrunat. Deg useggas n 149, d Ṛuma i ibeddlen tuttriwin-is, ticki Qarṭaǧ tessers leslaḥ-ines.
cmp.pairs.1.rome.d: Ṛuma, ɣas ulamma, tzerreɛ lmelḥ iwakken ulac ayen ara d-yemɣin.
cmp.pairs.1.known.d: Ulac adlis aqdim i t-id-ibedren : taqsist-agi d-tusa-d ɣer yimeskaren yuṛufiyen n lqern wis 19 d wis 20. Ṛuma, ssya d asawen, tuɣal tesbedd-d Qarṭaǧ lqern mbeɛd.
cmp.pairs.2.rome.d: Qarṭaǧ, akken i d-qqaren, tessen kan ttjara, war tsenɛet, war tasekla.
cmp.pairs.2.known.d: Akken i d-yeqqar Pline, deg 146, Ṛuma tefka ixxamen n yidlisen n Qarṭaǧ i igelliden inumidiyen. Agbur-nsen yexsar — ulac idlisen maci d ulac idles.
cmp.pairs.3.rome.d: Diodore d Plutarque beggnen-d isfal n warrac i yettemtekkin yal tikkelt.
cmp.pairs.3.known.d: Imesneɣzuyen ur mṣadan ara ɣef tofet : kra seg-sen ttwalin-t d asfel, wiyaḍ ttwalin-t ugar d tasga n imeḍlan n warrac imecṭuḥ yemmuten war ma ttwaneɣren.
cmp.pairs.3.known.link.label: Tofet akked yiyilluten n Qarṭaǧ
reads.0.d: Polybe d amddakel n Scipion Emilyen, win i yehuddun Qarṭaǧ. Tite-Live, ddaw Auguste, yura amezruy i ccan n Ṛuma, anda ara d-ttwafehhmen yir lweqt s talweɣ n uɛdaw.
reads.1.d: Turuft tɛadda iman-is d Ṛuma, « tamesnulfut », tga Qarṭaǧ d Ccerq abaṛbari — tugna n Salammbô n Flaubert (1862), cwiṭ send lḥima tafransist n 1881.
reads.2.d: Tiɣri n UNESCO « Sellket Qarṭaǧ » (1972–1995), imesneflulen Tunsiyen akked yiɣzuyen igraɣlanen, ɛawaden-d sbeddin tamdint-agi seg lateg-ines imi.
